crossRefs.note: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house.

parallels.note: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house.

people.name: Athaliah
people.line: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house:
translations.bsb: When Athaliah heard the noise from the guards and the people, she went out to the people in the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.
translations.asv: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the house of Jehovah:
